data.rationale: The proposal has the right goal, order and parameter (package), but it omits the "New note" click, the exact note format, and the close-tab/Back step. It also lumps stars and open issues into the Releases step, though they come from the repo page. That is enough to follow but leaves ambiguity for a build.
